content: {"summary":"Users report frequent random restarts during podcast playback, causing lost progress and frustration [#rv_-1929947434422323226][#rv_-2625762801862404443][#rv_-5074057797579201876]. The app’s UI is buggy, with disappearing controls and unresponsive play buttons, forcing users to force‑stop or reinstall the app [#rv_1068983455014319594][#rv_-3159312576296994856][#rv_-2259083489306530995]. Podcast recommendations are irrelevant and intrusive, cluttering the home screen and pushing unwanted content [#rv_1445099924151836756][#rv_4003958690389864362]. Users also complain about the inability to delete unwanted podcast folders and lack of multi‑select deletion in playlists [#rv_-5910242404741024754]. Overall, the experience is marred by instability, poor navigation, and unwanted content, leading to a largely negative sentiment. "}
